title: Long aliphatic chain-based spontaneous perovskite passivator: trade-off between the passivation effect and hole-transport material compatibility
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00929D, Paper
Naoyuki Nishimura, Takurou N. Murakami
Dodecylammonium-bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide (DDA-TFSI) acts as a long aliphatic chain-based spontaneous perovskite passivator and enhances the photovoltaic performance of perovskite solar cells despite resultant non-uniform spiro-OMeTAD layers.
